categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: consumer electronics and electric two-wheel vehicles. The consumer electronics segment includes manufacturing of display devices such as window protective screens, touch display modules, and precision structural components. The electric two-wheel vehicle segment focuses on the research, manufacturing, and sales of electric bicycles, electric motorcycles, and related accessories.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including 2D, 2.5D, 3D glass cover technologies, NCVM vacuum coating, laser engraving, and multi-layer composite films for window protective screens. In touch display modules, it uses high-precision transparent circuit etching, silver paste printing, FPC cable lamination, and Mini LED backlight technologies. Precision structural components utilize nano-injection molding, vacuum coating, metalization, and 3D printing. Electric two-wheel vehicles incorporate proprietary power systems, intelligent management systems, and advanced braking and anti-theft technologies. Production is highly automated with specialized lines for customized orders and lean manufacturing practices.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in consumer electronics such as smartphones, tablets, laptops, wearable devices, automotive electronics, industrial control, education electronics, and medical devices. The electric two-wheel vehicle products are sold mainly through dealers to end consumers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a focus on emerging markets in electric vehicles and high-end consumer electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases and subsidiaries in Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Guangdong, Guangxi, and Shenzhen. It also has expanding export markets for electric two-wheel vehicles in Europe, Asia, and North America. The company’s sales are predominantly domestic (over 77%) with about 23% from exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in the supply chain. It manufactures core components such as glass covers, touch modules, and precision parts (upstream/midstream) and also produces finished electric two-wheel vehicles (downstream). It integrates component manufacturing with final product assembly, forming a vertical industry chain from parts to finished goods.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating the integration of consumer electronics components with electric vehicle products to form a synergistic vertical supply chain. The company focuses on innovation in display and touch technologies, precision molding, and electric vehicle intelligent systems. R&D efforts target Mini LED gaming screens, 3D curved automotive displays, anti-theft POS screens, fingerprint recognition modules, and electric vehicle powertrain and safety enhancements. The company emphasizes smart manufacturing, automation, and digital management to improve efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of customized window protective screens, touch display modules, precision structural components, and electric two-wheel vehicles. Sales are conducted via direct sales for components and through dealer networks for electric vehicles. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and occasional asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated supplier in the display and electric two-wheel vehicle industries, leveraging proprietary technologies and a broad product portfolio. It competes with other manufacturers in consumer electronics components and electric vehicle sectors, aiming to be a niche leader and 'hidden champion' in specialized segments. Its strategic acquisition of subsidiaries and vertical integration enhance its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.2 billion, a 40.88% increase year-over-year, driven by growth in electric two-wheel vehicles and precision components. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 619 million, reflecting increased impairment losses and non-operating expenses. The company has expanded its consolidated subsidiaries and production capacity, indicating a growth trajectory despite current profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced technological capabilities, customization, and integration of components to deliver high-quality, innovative products. Its unique value lies in proprietary glass coating and touch technologies, precision molding expertise, and intelligent electric vehicle systems. The vertical integration from components to finished vehicles allows for cost control, supply chain efficiency, and rapid market response, providing customers with differentiated, high-performance, and cost-effective solutions.
